provenance: Tutor-authored practice prompts; no employer-question attribution, answers or learner results.

questions.scenario: A store report must retain customers without orders.
questions.task: Write a query returning each customer ID and actual order count; explain your grouping key.

questions.scenario: A small import has malformed amount text.
questions.task: Write a function returning valid and rejected rows without mutating input. Submit tests and explain your error boundary.
questions.expected_output: Valid IDs 1 and 3 with integer amounts 12 and 0; rejected ID 2 with a reason; input unchanged.

questions.scenario: A dated retail extract contains repeat product versions.
questions.task: Keep one latest version per product; state a deterministic tie rule and show tests.
questions.expected_output: P1 latest price 12; P2 price 4; explain behaviour if timestamps tie.

questions.scenario: An incremental copy fails after writing some rows.
questions.task: Explain what run evidence you inspect, how you decide a safe retry and when the watermark may change.
questions.sample_input: Old watermark 10:00; range ends 11:00; copy failed after a partial write.
questions.expected_output: An evidence-based diagnosis and recovery plan that can be tested for missing or duplicate rows.

questions.scenario: A job can list a container but cannot read one directory.
questions.task: Describe the checks you would run and the redacted evidence needed before changing access.
questions.sample_input: One application identity; read denied at /retail/day=2026-10-22/.
questions.expected_output: A bounded investigation distinguishing identity, scope and path permissions.

questions.scenario: A notebook works manually but its scheduled job fails.
questions.task: Explain how you isolate differences and verify a correction without exposing credentials.
questions.sample_input: Interactive run succeeds; job run reports access denied.
questions.expected_output: A sequence of evidence checks and a rerun verification plan.

questions.scenario: A changed product batch arrives twice.
questions.task: Implement or explain a tested update/load for the given batch; state duplicate-key assumptions.
questions.expected_output: Final P1=12, P2=4 once each; demonstrate repeated-run equivalence.

questions.scenario: A report must show the category applicable at sale time.
questions.task: Design the row grain, keys and historical example; show how you would verify an as-of result.
questions.sample_input: P1 category A before 2026-10-21, B from that date; sales on Oct 20 and Oct 22.
questions.expected_output: The first sale reports A and the second B; no double-counted sale.

questions.scenario: A daily workflow needs a bounded historical replay.
questions.task: Explain interval selection, task dependencies, validation and safe retry for a two-day backfill.
questions.sample_input: Daily run failed for Oct 20; Oct 21 already succeeded.
questions.expected_output: A replay/verification plan with explicit date boundaries and duplicate checks.

questions.scenario: A reporting model now produces duplicate product IDs.
questions.task: Describe how you investigate the failing test and verify the smallest correction.
questions.sample_input: Source product IDs unique; model unique-ID test fails after a new join.
questions.expected_output: Evidence locating the changed grain and checks of totals before/after correction.

questions.scenario: A loader cannot connect to its database service.
questions.task: Explain the checks and reproduce a minimal fix in a safe local environment.
questions.sample_input: Loader container uses localhost:5432; database is a separate Compose service.
questions.expected_output: Connection and readiness evidence plus a persistence check after recreation.

questions.scenario: A pipeline change passes locally but fails in CI.
questions.task: Explain investigation, review and rollback evidence for a bounded change.
questions.sample_input: CI cannot import a dependency installed manually on the laptop.
questions.expected_output: Reproducible dependency/test evidence and a reviewed change; no production deployment assumed.

prerequisites: Managed identity, secret references and run logs
questions.scenario: A previously working pipeline reports secret access denied.
questions.task: Explain identity/scope checks and what to alert on; show how you redact evidence.
questions.sample_input: One failed run ID, a Key Vault reference and no confirmed configuration change.
questions.expected_output: A least-privilege investigation and useful alert proposal without secret disclosure.

questions.scenario: A dashboard total doubled after a rerun.
questions.task: Describe detection, containment, investigation, safe recovery and regression tests.
questions.sample_input: Input count 100; first result 100; rerun result 200.
questions.expected_output: An evidence-based incident explanation with explicit unknowns and verified recovery criteria.

prerequisites: Ingestion, modelling, orchestration and cloud boundaries
questions.scenario: A fictional retailer needs a small daily analytics pipeline.
questions.task: Sketch the simplest justified design; explain correctness, failures, security, cost and tool tradeoffs.
questions.sample_input: Daily small product/sales files, next-morning reporting, limited cloud budget.
questions.expected_output: A coherent design and test plan with assumptions; no requirement to include every tool.

questions.scenario: An interviewer asks about your Azure production experience.
questions.task: Give a two-minute truthful answer connecting database support/development strengths with verified RRDAP practice and remaining gaps.
questions.sample_input: Use only actual employment responsibilities and saved educational project evidence.
questions.expected_output: Clear separation of employment, simulation, actual cloud runs and unverified plans.
